questions.content:
Match each of the compounds in Column I with its characteristic reaction(s) in Column II.

Column I Column II
(A) (P) Reduction with
(B) (Q) Reduction with
(C) (R) Development of foul smell on treatment with chloroform and alcoholic KOH
(D) (S) Reduction with diisobutylaluminium hydride (DIBAL-H)
(T) Alkaline hydrolysis
